action_items.detail: journey-select-and-switch check had a stale assumption (arena '-lock' testid) from an earlier app version where arenas unlocked sequentially; current spec has all 3 arenas open from the start (spec_deviations). Fixed the check to assert all 3 arena-enter buttons are visible instead of a lock badge.

partial-and-learning-outcomes check wrongly asserted hearts stayed at 3 after an O3 learning outcome; acceptance matrix confirms learning attacks (G3/I3/O3) cost exactly one heart. Fixed assertion to expect hearts=2 after O3, matching observed (correct) app behavior.

checks.criterion: Opening cinematic + journey select still work after refactor
checks.name: opening-cinematic-flow
checks.evidence: Title -> 'Start the Story' -> 4 cinematic beats with typewriter text, Next/Replay/Skip Intro visible, Skip Intro and Replay both exercised -> 'Choose your path' screen with both journey buttons visible.

checks.criterion: Opening cinematic + journey select still work after refactor (journey select + switching)
checks.name: journey-select-and-switch
checks.evidence: Fixed stale lock-testid assumption; verified Shivam hub shows 3 arena-enter buttons (all open), hub switch button and HUD menu 'switch journey' both correctly toggle between Father/Shivam hubs.

checks.criterion: Father's Journey: all 9 question attacks resolve with the JSON outcome
checks.name: father-attack-sequence-g1
checks.evidence: G1 attack launched, flight/scanning animation, battle-result[data-outcome=proven], 'Shivam used [power] from his resume!', Show Me Proof panel with metric tiles, Continue returns to arena.

checks.criterion: Father's Journey: partial (O2) and learning (O3) outcomes + hearts
checks.name: partial-and-learning-outcomes
checks.evidence: O2 -> battle-result[data-outcome=partial] with battle-partial-supports/not-claimed, Not Convinced Yet scope panel. O3 -> data-outcome=learning, 'Resume Power Not Found', transferable+learning-plan shown, hearts dropped 3->2 (fixed script assertion to match spec), proof panel '0 of 21', replaying O3 does not double-count resolved attacks.

checks.criterion: Three-heart system + Infinite Learner comeback; Learning Journal persistence
checks.name: persistence-refresh-and-restart
checks.evidence: G3 learning -> hearts 3->2, journal count 1; page reload preserves hearts=2 and journal=1; I3 -> hearts 1; O3 -> comeback dialog 'Hero abhi haara nahi hai!' auto-opens over result, Continue restores hearts=1, journal=3; HUD menu restart journey resets hearts to 3.

checks.criterion: Proof spotlight + seals gate the finale
checks.name: papa-mood-progression-and-seals
checks.evidence: G1 proven raises Papa mood to curious/impressed stages; opening Proof Spotlight after resolving an attack earns the Experimentation seal (journey-seals count increments).

checks.criterion: Shivam's Journey: 3 monster battles (weak/strong cards, journal, spotlight)
checks.name: shivam-monster-battle-and-journal
checks.evidence: Growth arena shows business problem + 3 move-play cards; weak card -> monster-retry-button shown, Learning Journal entry added (count 1, note '#1 - The Budget Beast...'); strong card -> win, arena-open-spotlight-button reachable.

checks.criterion: Miss Growth finale + ending on both journeys
checks.name: miss-growth-finale-and-ending
checks.evidence: After resolving 1 attack + opening spotlight in each of 3 father arenas, 'Meet Miss Growth' becomes visible on hub; finale steps through finale-next-button, finale-choice-creators, finale-lock-in-button to finale-rishta-shortlisted with Papa/Miss Growth ending lines, confetti, tagline 'A finite challenge. An infinite learner.' and fictional-game-achievement disclaimer.

checks.name: resume-power-vault-drawer
checks.evidence: Vault drawer opens showing 21 cards, filter by achievement type works, tapping a card expands its detail.

checks.criterion: Backend API data integrity for game engine
checks.name: test_tscheck_game_engine_data.py
checks.evidence: GET http://localhost:8001/api/game -> 200; 3 pytest cases passed validating engine.json structure (father_attacks, arenas, powers) served to the frontend.
